Description.value: Fixes the full server freeze caused by a lock-order deadlock between MultiBlockManager, RegionFileManager and the chunk unload path when MaxChunkAge chunk reset is enabled. Contended locks are taken non-blocking and the work is replayed on the main thread instead of being dropped. Adds chunk reset logging and a main thread watchdog, both switchable in Config.xml with hot reload. See README.md for details. Built for game version 3.x.
